razor_priya: Pattern: I guessed sink_ba_ba1 at 07:16 on day 15. Reality: It was at bathroom_shelf_ba1. Next time: Do not default to sink_ba_ba1. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first for this item.

water_bottle_priya: Pattern: I guessed dish_rack_k1 at 11:38 and coffee_table_l1 at 19:54 on day 15. Reality: It was at coffee_table_l1 at 11:38 and kitchen_table_k1 at 19:54. On day 16 at 09:19, I guessed kitchen_table_k1, but it was at coffee_table_l1. Next time: This item rotates between coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1. Do not default to dish_rack_k1. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning and mid-day queries. Check kitchen_table_k1 for evening queries.

glass_priya: Pattern: I guessed coffee_table_l1 at 20:26 on day 15. Reality: It was at kitchen_table_k1. Next time: Do not default to coffee_table_l1 for evening queries. Check kitchen_table_k1 for late afternoon/evening. It also appears at counter_k1 late at night.

General Note: Avoid rigid location rules for mug_priya, water_bottle_priya, and glass_priya. These items move frequently between kitchen and living areas. For mug_priya, valid spots are kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. For water_bottle_priya, coffee_table_l1 is likely for morning and mid-day, while kitchen_table_k1 is likely for evening. For glass_priya, kitchen_table_k1 is a strong candidate for evening, and counter_k1 for late night. Always prioritize recent specific evidence. Do not default to bedroom spots (desk_b1, nightstand_b1) or dish_rack_k1 for these items unless there is specific evidence.
